async def act(page):
    # Scroll to the bottom of the homepage
    await page.evaluate('window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)')
    # Wait for any dynamic content to load after scrolling
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # 2 seconds delay

        page3_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='3')
        await page3_link.click()
    except:
        # If not found, try alternative selectors
        try:
            page3_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Page 3')
            await page3_link.click()
        except:
            # If still not found, scroll more or inspect, but task is guaranteed possible
            # As a fallback, scroll again and wait
            await page.evaluate('window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)')
            await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
            # Try again with a broader search
            page3_link = page.get_by_role('link').filter(has_text='3')
            await page3_link.first.click()
    
    # Wait for navigation to page 3 to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
